decisions.reason: Devore fabric is close to the established decorative line, and with no negative sales signal, the low cost of keeping the option open justifies continued presence.
Transparent burnout is a low-cost variant of existing decorative fabrics, and its demand uncertainty still supports keeping the option open.
Burnout decorative fabric remains a core-adjacent option with little evidence of failure, so it is kept as a low-cost extension.
Velour-like upholstery builds on existing upholstery strengths, and its option value is retained given low incremental cost and no adverse results.
Flame-retardant inbetween fabric serves a specific customer requirement and leverages existing capabilities, so it is kept as a valuable option.
Polyester lining with satin sheen is a low-cost complement to the product range, and without negative data the option is kept open.
